name: de.itsfullofstars.sap.pam
description: SAP Support Radar - check your SAP products' support status against the SAP Product Availability Matrix.
author: Tobias Hofmann

scripts.clean: rimraf dist coverage .nyc_output test-results playwright-report allure-results allure-report sbom.json sbom-report.html
scripts.start-cdn: npm run pam:import && ui5 serve --port 8080 -o index-cdn.html
scripts.start-coverage: npm run pam:import && ui5 serve --port 8080 --config ui5-coverage.yaml
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run ui5lint && npm run ts-typecheck && npm run ts-typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:e2e
scripts.start: npm run ts-typecheck && npm run pam:import && ui5 serve --port 8080 -o index.html
scripts.start-local: npm run pam:import && ui5 --config ui5-local.yaml serve --port 8080
scripts.build: npm run ts-typecheck && npm run pam:import && ui5 build -a --clean-dest --include-task=generateCachebusterInfo
scripts.build:opt: npm run pam:import && ui5 build self-contained --clean-dest --all
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:coverage:report
scripts.sbom:report: npm run sbom && ts-node -P scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/sbom-report.ts
